player_prompt.intro:
A nyi azɔnwla {player_id} le Nim.
A wɛzɔn wɛ nyi azɔn wɛ xwɛ mɛ gbe.
Le kɔ ɖi ɖi, ɖɔ xwɛ kɔ kan ɖɔ kɔ pile, bɔ kɔ kan ɖɔ kɔ kɔ sɔ kɔ kɔ.
Xɔ se format '[pile quantity]', pile wɛ pile tɔn ɖɔ kɔ quantity wɛ sɔ kɔ kɔ.
A nyi azɔn wɛ xwɛ, '[0 3]' bɔ 3 sɔ kɔ kɔ pile 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: E mɔ̀ nùɖé e è na yí ɔ́ ǎ. Zɔ '[pile quantity]' bo sɔ́ dó wlan nǔ é ɖé ná.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Akpɛvi {player_id}, Wàxlɛ̀ nu mɛ gblɛ. Kolɔnnu {col} do hɛn ɖo tɛn mɛ.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Akɔ́nkpá {pile_index} ɖò fí e è nɔ sɔ́ ɛ dó lɛ é ǎ.
invalid_move.non_positive: E na nɔ ɖe nǔ ɖokpo ɖò hweɖelɛnu.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Eɖi mɛ na yi {quantity} sɔn pile {pile_index} (mɛna sɔnna {pile_count} blae).

observation.removed_from_piles: A nyi azɔnwla {player_id} xwɛ [{pile_index} {quantity}], bɔ {quantity} sɔ kɔ kɔ pile {pile_index}.

outcome.win: {player_id} ɔ́ yí nǔ e ɖò gudo é (s)!
